newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Evening Standard - May 12.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company

POLICE MARKSMEN 'CAN'T HIT THE MARK' A report by Superintendent Colin Burrows of the Royal Ulster Constabulary has found that highly trained police marksmen miss their targets two out of three times, when confronted with dangerous gunmen.
LLOYD'S CAMPAIGNER IS SUED BY NAMES

Christopher Stockwell, who has been an exceptionally vigorous campaigner for compensation for Lloyd's names, has been sued in a row over payments he is seeking for his work. Rugby Estates, the property group, is to buy a 40,000 sq ft freehold property in Covent Garden in an 8.4 million stg deal. The property has retail, residential, restaurant and office accommodation, and the purchase price includes an initial 8 percent a year rental yield, which Rugby expects will increase to over 10 percent.
